title: Starry Form: Chalice
html:
Starry Form: Chalice is a bonus action available to Circle of the Stars druids. It lets them enter a  Starry Form where they gain a free healing action that recharges every time they cast a healing spell.

Description

A constellation of a life-giving chalice appears on you. Whenever you cast a healing spell that consumes a spell slot, you can cast  Chalice Healing.

Properties

Cost
 Bonus Action +  Wild Shape Charge
Details
 Range: Self
Duration: Until Long rest

At higher levels

  • At level 2, Chalice Healing heals 1d8 + Wisdom modifier⁠Healing.
  • At level 10 with  Twinkling Constellations, Chalice Healing heals 2d8 + Wisdom modifier⁠Healing.

This spell is a variation of:
Starry Form

Notes

  • This action is listed in the  Wild Shape container ability along with the normal wild shape forms.
  • The criteria for refreshing  Chalice Healing are somewhat restrictive. The following spells work:
    •  Healing Word
    •  Mass Healing Word
    •  Cure Wounds
    •  Mass Cure Wounds
    •  Vampiric Touch (including its free recasts)
    •  Prayer of Healing
    •  Heal
  • Chalice Healing does not refresh when casting any other spell or any other healing action. These include:
    •  Goodberry
    •  Warden of Vitality or  Restore Vitality
    •  Aid
    • The versions of  Healing Word and  Mass Healing Word granted by  Amulet of Restoration
    •  Selûne's Dream from  Amulet of Selûne's Chosen
    • Any spell that grants  temporary hit points instead of healing
    • Any non-spell actions which heal such as  Lay on Hands or  Transfuse Health
    • Healing with a non-healing spell through an effect like  Perilous Stakes or  Circlet of Mental Anguish
